name: Sora triple left/right shift/brake control pair
weight_description: Not yet sourced: complete left ST-3303 triple / right ST-3300 eight-speed shift/brake pair. The service sheet gives the exact side models but no pair or individual side weights; the known ST-3300 double pair weight is not transferred or doubled.
